summary: States the problem of letting many systems talk directly to each other over IPsec when setting up every tunnel by hand is too burdensome, endpoint addresses change, or NAT gets in the way. It then lists requirements for an Auto-Discovery VPN solution that would set up such tunnels dynamically.

eli5.summary: If lots of offices each need a private tunnel to every other office, setting them all up by hand is a mess. This asks for a system that builds the tunnels as needed.

questions: dynamic ipsec tunnels between many sites
